note: Set A is empty and therefore misses all figure content, but Set B's eight claims are uniformly misbound: the percentages (15%, 25%, 33%, 44%, 54%, 64%, 77%, 100%) are x-axis span-position labels, not thickness values, while the plotted quantity is Thickness [mm] for materials such as CarbonUD, Gelcoat and glass_biax. The quoted strings do appear in the text layer, but they support only span-position labels, not 'shear layup layer thickness = 54%' style claims, and the entities (FFA-W3-xxx) are span stations rather than components with a thickness property. Since every one of B's claims is misread/misbound and none is correct, the empty set A incurs fewer errors, though it also captures nothing.
